title: Simulation Pace
text: Set simulation rate for animation viewing, 1 output, {Sample time} sets Sample time; {Simulation pace} sets the ratio of simulation time to clock time, {Sleep mode} controls simulation pace and {Output pace error} displays pace error. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Simulation pace
params.values: Ratio of simulation time to clock time 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Sleep mode
params.values: Control simulation pace Auto (default) | MATLAB Thread | Off | Busy-Wait
